description: This file defines the CustomerOptionValue entity class used to represent customer option values with descriptions, images, and related metadata in an e-commerce system. It includes JPA annotations for ORM mapping and contains fields for code, image, descriptions, merchant store association, and sort order.

classes.name: CustomerOptionValue
classes.description: Entity class representing customer option values, including identification, sorting, image data, descriptions, and associated merchant store.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the primary key ID of the customer option value.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the primary key ID of the customer option value.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves the set of descriptions for the customer option value.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the descriptions for the customer option value.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with this customer option value.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with this customer option value.

methods.name: getDescriptionsSettoList
methods.description: Converts the set of descriptions to a list and returns it.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the image file for this customer option value.

methods.name: getCustomerOptionValueImage
methods.description: Gets the image filename or URL associated with this customer option value.

methods.name: setCustomerOptionValueImage
methods.description: Sets the image filename or URL.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code identifier for this customer option value.
